description.value:
From Spice Girl · Price: touch only; softened things become rubber, and that can include your footing.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: your stand softens an object; it's rubbery, Hardness 0, and bounces.
  • 5: Softened ground: creatures falling onto it take no damage, and a creature knocked onto it bounces 10 ft.
  • 9: Surge: soften a creature's weapon or armor: weapon damage is halved, or AC –2 for 1 minute (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 13: Soften a 20-ft area of wall or floor: difficult terrain, and you can push through it like water.
  • 17: Soften a creature's body (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude}): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 2} and it can squeeze, but it also can't hold anything for 1 round.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.FWzQbZUMhOQxSUq9]{Effect: Softened Armor}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
